definitions.explanation: The contrast or range between cold and hot temperatures. Used in technical, engineering, and everyday contexts to discuss temperature fluctuations and their effects on materials or environments.

examples.japanese: {冷熱|れいねつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: The difference between cold and heat is extreme.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷熱|れいねつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This material is resistant to thermal variation.

examples.japanese: {冷熱|れいねつ}サイクル⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}→耐久性：20042_taikyuusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: We verify product durability through thermal cycling tests.

notes:
A compound of {冷|れい} (cold) and ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat). This is an example of a paired-opposite compound ({対義|たいぎ}{複合語|ふくごうご}), similar to ⟦{寒暖|かんだん}→寒暖：05561_kandan⟧ (cold and warm). Frequently appears in engineering and materials science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷熱|れいねつ}サイクル: thermal cycle
- {冷熱|れいねつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: thermal test
- {冷熱|れいねつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: temperature difference
- {冷熱|れいねつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: resistant to temperature extremes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寒暖|かんだん}→寒暖：05561_kandan⟧: cold and warm — refers to atmospheric temperature variation, as in weather or seasonal changes
- ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: temperature — the measurement of heat itself
- {温冷|おんれい}: warm and cold — used in contexts like alternating hot and cold baths ({温冷|おんれい}{浴|よく})
